name: EAGLE-2 acceptance length and speedup on LLaMA2-Chat 70B (temperature=0)
methodology: temperature=0, MT-bench dataset. Average acceptance length τ = 4.48 tokens per draft-verify cycle. Speedup 3.51x.
notes: EAGLE-2 with draft tree depth 6, 48 total draft tokens. Draft model is LLaMA2-Chat 7B. Baseline is vanilla autoregressive decoding.
